entities.name: L. S. Ettre

entities.summary: Leslie Stephen Ettre was a Hungarian-American analytical chemist and scientist who was known for his contributions to the field of chromatography, in particular open-tubular gas chromatography, as well as to documentation of the history of chromatography.
